ops-broadcast: :rotating_light: MAINTENANCE & POLICY BROADCAST: We are introducing a new Maintenance Notification Policy and running a combined simulated blackout + load validation on Fri 2026-09-10 03:00-04:30 UTC. Please read and ack if you are available to observe.

ops-broadcast: High level: new policy formalizes a 72h pre-notice for production maintenance that could affect client-visible latency/errors. It also establishes a Temporary SLO Adjustment (TSA) mechanism for planned windows so we can reduce noisy pages but still detect true regressions. Test: on 2026-09-10 we'll execute a controlled cross-region blackout simulation + synthetic load at ~1.7x baseline to validate TSA behavior and autoscaler limits.

ops-broadcast: Policy bullets:
- 72h pre-notice for any maintenance flagged as "Potentially Impacting" in the scheduler.
- TSA: during approved windows, SRE may apply a temporary fold to p99 thresholds per-service (configurable per-tier). Tiers: gold=1.25x, silver=1.5x, bronze=2.0x.
- TSA only affects oncall paging thresholds; metric collection remains unchanged. All TSA windows are logged for post-test SLA reconciliation.

marta: Why? Our oncall rotation has too many noisy pages during routine maint. TSA keeps us paging on real regressions while reducing pager fatigue. It also gives product teams a predictable envelope for scheduled ops.

josh: Test plan (summary):
- 03:00 UTC: start ramping synthetics to 1.7x over 12 minutes (gradual).
- 03:15 UTC: inject regional routing blackhole in us-east-1 (simulate network partition), shifting ~35% traffic to other regions.
- 03:28 UTC: trigger partial pool deletion (scale target app nodes down by 30%) to mimic capacity loss.
- 03:50 UTC: begin recovery and scale back to baseline.
- 04:10 UTC: run smoke/regression suite + snapshot metrics.

rachel: Safety & aborts:
- Abort if global error rate delta > 2% sustained for 8m.
- Abort if p99 exceeds tier*2 for 10m.
- Autoscaler cap enforced: max scale factor = 2.0x for test to avoid cascading cloud bills.

oncall: Coverage: I'll be primary during the window, @rachel on fallback. If you can't cover please state here; we will pair you with someone who can watch. Also set DND for non-oncall engineers for the window.

sam: Customer comms: I'll draft a short pre-test status page note we can publish 24h before the test. Suggested text: "Planned resilience validation: transient errors/latency may be observed; no data loss expected."

ops-broadcast: Runbook + config: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maintenance-policy-tsa and the test playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/resilience-sim-20260910. Key CLI for observers: 
```
# open the guard dashboard for the test
make viz test-guard-resilience

# pause synthetic ramp if you need to stop
infractl jobs pause resil-test-20260910
```

josh: Metrics to watch (quick list): open connections, KVcache hit ratio, fallback-counts, route-fallback-rate, p50/p95/p99 latencies, errors by client SDK. If KVcache miss rate > baseline*1.15, throttle the synthetics and hold the failover step.

rachel: Rollback triggers in runbook:
- >2% global error increase for 8m -> auto-pause and notify #eng-sre
- p99 > tier*2 for 10m -> immediate rollback
- reconnection rate > 1.8x baseline for 5m -> pause and investigate
On triggers, infra-bot will issue `resil-test:abort` and begin recovery actions.

infra-bot: Scheduled: resil-test-20260910 created. Canary region: us-west-2 at 03:00 UTC. Step delays: ramp=720s, blackhole=780s, drain=600s, recover=1200s. Notifications will post to #ops-log and to incident-runner.

oncall: Post-test verification steps:
- verify canary service health checks pass
- run `synthetic/ingress-smoke` and confirm <1% error
- capture SLO-reconciled report (TSA vs baseline) and attach to incident doc
- assign any remediation tickets within 5 working days

marta: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you'll be watching live, or :eyes: if you will only review the post-test notes. We'll need at least 2 watchers per region for 03:00 UTC.

ops-broadcast: Final reminder: this is a controlled exercise. If you are offshift and see alerts, wait for oncall instructions. We'll publish the final runbook and rollback list 48h before the test. Posting updates to this thread during the run. :rocket:
